R\. N\. Cust\.
Grammatical note and vocabulary of the language of the kor\-kū, a kolarian tribe in central india\.
*Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland*, 16\(2\):164–179, 1884\.
Cust communicated the material and on p\. 164 inferred from internal evidence that Albert Norton, a missionary working among Korku at Ellichpūr, probably composed the found vocabulary\. Exact speaker and elicitation site are not identified\. Original romanization is preserved in source rows\. Matching later Pinnow, Zoller, Noira and Stahl strings are independent witness attestations; no borrowing or etymology edge is inferred\.
